metadata.title: Zoledronic Acid Monotherapy
metadata.indication: Adjuvant treatment of breast cancer in endocrine-depleted pre- or post-menopausal women.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Source reconciled · independent clinical/pharmacy review pending
encoding_maturity.scope_note: NCCP 00545 v3 reviewed with separately identified EMA safety guidance; source gaps require consultant review.

metadata.catalogue_source_check_scope: Catalogue presence and source link structure only; not rule level source fidelity.

source_supplements.title: EMA Zoledronic Acid Accord SmPC
source_supplements.scope: Supplementary safety and renal method; NCCP controls the adjuvant schedule

metadata.course_summary: IV infusion every 6 months for up to 5 years, or earlier for progression or unacceptable toxicity; confirm the individual adjuvant plan.
metadata.schedule_summary: Zoledronic acid by IV infusion once every six months for up to five years, unless progression or unacceptable toxicity changes the plan. The usual source dose is 4 mg, with renal review before prescribing.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Any dose modification should be discussed with a Consultant.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding of the NCCP source document. It does not replace the current NCCP regimen, clinical judgement, local policy, prescribing review, or pharmacy verification.
clinical_governance.off_label_note: NCCP p4 identifies adjuvant use as off-label in Ireland. Explain this, obtain consent under local policy, and confirm Drugs and Therapeutics Committee or equivalent acknowledgement.

indications.description: Adjuvant treatment of breast cancer in endocrine-depleted pre- or post-menopausal women.

treatment_phases.label: Adjuvant zoledronic acid
treatment_phases.duration_text: Every 6 calendar months for up to 5 years, stopping earlier for disease progression or unacceptable toxicity. The day count is a display approximation, not an appointment interval.

administration.notes: Renal-adjusted if required; 100 mL sodium chloride 0.9% over at least 15 minutes. Every 6 months, not every 3–4 weeks or once yearly. Confirm hydration and avoid fluid overload.

cycle_number.label: Cycle number
cycle_number.assessment_guidance: Record the actual infusion number; calendar-month timing is confirmed by the treatment plan, not calculated from this number.

crcl.label: Creatinine clearance (Cockcroft–Gault; not indexed eGFR)

renal_input.reason: Exact values preserve >60 and expose the printed 39–40 and 49–50 gaps without silently rounding a calculated creatinine clearance.

crcl.assessment_guidance: Use verified Cockcroft–Gault CrCl in mL/min. Do not substitute indexed eGFR or round across source gaps.

baseline_creatinine.label: Baseline creatinine
baseline_creatinine.assessment_guidance: Use the treatment baseline. Change and recovery ratio are calculated from this and the current result; baseline exactly 124 is an unresolved source boundary.

current_creatinine.label: Current creatinine
current_creatinine.assessment_guidance: Enter the current verified value in µmol/L; no manual delta or recovery percentage is needed.

hypocalcaemia.label: Hypocalcaemia present
hypocalcaemia.assessment_guidance: Confirm interpretation using the reporting laboratory and clinical context; corrected or ionised calcium may be appropriate. This source gives no universal numerical calcium threshold.

dental_onj_concern.label: Dental concern or suspected osteonecrosis of the jaw

renal_deterioration_clinically_present.label: Clinical renal deterioration / acute kidney injury

unhealed_oral_lesion.label: Unhealed open soft-tissue lesion in the mouth

invasive_dental_procedure_planned.label: Invasive dental procedure planned or recently performed

dental_risk_assessment_unresolved.label: Dental risk assessment or indicated preventive dentistry unresolved

off_label_governance_confirmed.label: Adjuvant off-label discussion, consent and local governance confirmed

pretreatment_tests_unresolved.label: Required pre-dose blood tests or results unresolved

calcium_vitamin_d_plan_unresolved.label: Calcium / vitamin D replacement plan unresolved

fluid_overload_risk.label: Risk of fluid overload / cardiac failure

concurrent_other_bisphosphonate.label: Concurrent other bisphosphonate / duplicate zoledronic acid

interaction_review_unresolved.label: Renal, calcium-lowering or antiangiogenic medicine interaction unresolved

severe_hypocalcaemia_symptoms.label: Tetany, seizures, arrhythmia or other severe hypocalcaemia symptoms

new_thigh_hip_groin_pain.label: New thigh, hip or groin pain

persistent_ear_symptoms.label: Persistent ear pain, discharge or infection

new_eye_pain_or_vision_change.label: New eye pain or visual disturbance

severe_systemic_reaction.label: Severe acute systemic reaction / suddenly unwell

output_templates.proceed: Entered values do not trigger an encoded hold or dose-adjustment rule.
output_templates.delay: Withhold and correct the identified abnormality before treatment.
output_templates.dose_reduce: Use the renal-adjusted dose shown and obtain prescribing/pharmacy verification.
output_templates.consultant_review: Consultant/pharmacy review is required before the treatment plan is confirmed.
output_templates.withhold: Withhold pending review and correction of the identified problem; this does not authorise a later dose.
output_templates.contraindicated: A source exclusion or not-recommended pathway applies; confirm an alternative clinical plan.

action.recommendation: Do not administer zoledronic acid with relevant bisphosphonate or excipient hypersensitivity.

rules.explanation: Do not administer zoledronic acid with relevant bisphosphonate or excipient hypersensitivity.

action.recommendation: Pregnancy or breastfeeding excludes this regimen.

rules.explanation: Pregnancy or breastfeeding excludes this regimen.

action.recommendation: Correct the identified calcium, magnesium or phosphate abnormality before treatment; establish the replacement and repeat-test plan.

rules.explanation: Correct the identified calcium, magnesium or phosphate abnormality before treatment; establish the replacement and repeat-test plan.

action.recommendation: CrCl below 30 mL/min: zoledronic acid is not recommended; severe renal impairment is an NCCP exclusion.

rules.explanation: CrCl below 30 mL/min: zoledronic acid is not recommended; severe renal impairment is an NCCP exclusion.

action.recommendation: CrCl 30–39 mL/min: source dose is 3 mg zoledronic acid. Consultant/pharmacy verification remains required; this does not override renal deterioration, electrolyte or dental holds.

rules.explanation: CrCl 30–39 mL/min: source dose is 3 mg zoledronic acid. Consultant/pharmacy verification remains required; this does not override renal deterioration, electrolyte or dental holds.

action.recommendation: CrCl 40–49 mL/min: source dose is 3.3 mg zoledronic acid. Consultant/pharmacy verification remains required; this does not override renal deterioration, electrolyte or dental holds.

rules.explanation: CrCl 40–49 mL/min: source dose is 3.3 mg zoledronic acid. Consultant/pharmacy verification remains required; this does not override renal deterioration, electrolyte or dental holds.

action.recommendation: CrCl 50–60 mL/min: source dose is 3.5 mg zoledronic acid. Consultant/pharmacy verification remains required; this does not override renal deterioration, electrolyte or dental holds.

rules.explanation: CrCl 50–60 mL/min: source dose is 3.5 mg zoledronic acid. Consultant/pharmacy verification remains required; this does not override renal deterioration, electrolyte or dental holds.

action.recommendation: CrCl between 39 and 40 mL/min is unassigned by the printed whole-number rows. Do not round into a dose; resolve the source gap with the consultant/pharmacist.

rules.explanation: CrCl between 39 and 40 mL/min is unassigned by the printed whole-number rows. Do not round into a dose; resolve the source gap with the consultant/pharmacist.

action.recommendation: Verify Cockcroft–Gault creatinine clearance before applying this dose table; indexed eGFR is not interchangeable.

rules.explanation: Verify Cockcroft–Gault creatinine clearance before applying this dose table; indexed eGFR is not interchangeable.

action.recommendation: Baseline creatinine exactly 124 µmol/L is unassigned between the printed <124 and >124 deterioration categories. Resolve the boundary; neither threshold is automatically selected.

rules.explanation: Baseline creatinine exactly 124 µmol/L is unassigned between the printed <124 and >124 deterioration categories. Resolve the boundary; neither threshold is automatically selected.

action.recommendation: Withhold for renal deterioration: the current creatinine rise reaches at least 44 µmol/L in the applicable baseline category. Review the cause, repeat renal tests and reassess before any restart.

source.interpretation: The source increase-of threshold is interpreted monotonically as at least that rise, using verified baseline/current values.

rules.explanation: Withhold for renal deterioration: the current creatinine rise reaches at least 44 µmol/L in the applicable baseline category. Review the cause, repeat renal tests and reassess before any restart.

action.recommendation: Withhold for renal deterioration: the current creatinine rise reaches at least 88 µmol/L in the applicable baseline category. Review the cause, repeat renal tests and reassess before any restart.

source.interpretation: The source increase-of threshold is interpreted monotonically as at least that rise, using verified baseline/current values.

rules.explanation: Withhold for renal deterioration: the current creatinine rise reaches at least 88 µmol/L in the applicable baseline category. Review the cause, repeat renal tests and reassess before any restart.

action.recommendation: Withhold and clinically assess renal deterioration or acute kidney injury even if a numerical trigger is not established.

rules.explanation: Withhold and clinically assess renal deterioration or acute kidney injury even if a numerical trigger is not established.

action.recommendation: Both baseline and current creatinine are needed to assess renal deterioration and recovery. A lone value cannot establish a safe trend.

rules.explanation: Both baseline and current creatinine are needed to assess renal deterioration and recovery. A lone value cannot establish a safe trend.

action.recommendation: Continue withholding after renal deterioration: current creatinine remains more than 10% above baseline. Review recovery before considering another infusion.

rules.explanation: Continue withholding after renal deterioration: current creatinine remains more than 10% above baseline. Review recovery before considering another infusion.

action.recommendation: Creatinine is at or below 110% of baseline. The source permits consideration of resumption after recovery, at the same dose used before interruption; confirm that dose, current renal status and all other requirements. Do not recalculate a new starting dose automatically.

source.interpretation: Recovery from a rise is interpreted as no more than 10% above baseline; resumption remains a consultant decision.

rules.explanation: Creatinine is at or below 110% of baseline. The source permits consideration of resumption after recovery, at the same dose used before interruption; confirm that dose, current renal status and all other requirements. Do not recalculate a new starting dose automatically.

action.recommendation: Renal-hold restart requires both baseline/current creatinine and verification of the pre-interruption dose; no restart clearance or new dose is calculated.

rules.explanation: Renal-hold restart requires both baseline/current creatinine and verification of the pre-interruption dose; no restart clearance or new dose is calculated.

action.recommendation: Hepatic-impairment data are limited and no specific adjustment is supplied. Obtain individual consultant/pharmacy advice rather than an invented dose.

rules.explanation: Hepatic-impairment data are limited and no specific adjustment is supplied. Obtain individual consultant/pharmacy advice rather than an invented dose.

action.recommendation: Withhold pending dental/oral-surgery and oncology review for suspected osteonecrosis of the jaw or a significant dental concern; subsequent interruption and treatment are individualised.

source.interpretation: Temporary withholding pending assessment is a safety interpretation; SmPC advises considering interruption for established ONJ.

rules.explanation: Withhold pending dental/oral-surgery and oncology review for suspected osteonecrosis of the jaw or a significant dental concern; subsequent interruption and treatment are individualised.

action.recommendation: Delay starting a new treatment course until unhealed open oral soft-tissue lesions have been assessed and healed; resolve the dental plan.

rules.explanation: Delay starting a new treatment course until unhealed open oral soft-tissue lesions have been assessed and healed; resolve the dental plan.

action.recommendation: Unhealed oral lesions need prompt dental and oncology review before the next infusion; confirm treatment stage and whether a hold is required.

rules.explanation: Unhealed oral lesions need prompt dental and oncology review before the next infusion; confirm treatment stage and whether a hold is required.

action.recommendation: Coordinate invasive dental work with dentistry and oncology. Avoid close proximity to zoledronic acid where possible; evidence does not define a universal drug-holiday interval or prove that stopping eliminates ONJ risk.

rules.explanation: Coordinate invasive dental work with dentistry and oncology. Avoid close proximity to zoledronic acid where possible; evidence does not define a universal drug-holiday interval or prove that stopping eliminates ONJ risk.

action.recommendation: Complete the indicated dental assessment, preventive care and individual benefit-risk review before treatment.

rules.explanation: Complete the indicated dental assessment, preventive care and individual benefit-risk review before treatment.

action.recommendation: This is the adjuvant breast regimen. Metastatic bone disease, tumour-induced hypercalcaemia and osteoporosis require their own indication and schedule; do not substitute them here.

rules.explanation: This is the adjuvant breast regimen. Metastatic bone disease, tumour-induced hypercalcaemia and osteoporosis require their own indication and schedule; do not substitute them here.

action.recommendation: Confirm endocrine depletion for this adjuvant indication. Premenopausal status alone does not establish eligibility without an appropriate suppression/depletion plan.

rules.explanation: Confirm endocrine depletion for this adjuvant indication. Premenopausal status alone does not establish eligibility without an appropriate suppression/depletion plan.

action.recommendation: Adjuvant zoledronic acid is off-label in Ireland under this source. Complete the patient discussion/consent and local Drugs and Therapeutics Committee or equivalent process.

rules.explanation: Adjuvant zoledronic acid is off-label in Ireland under this source. Complete the patient discussion/consent and local Drugs and Therapeutics Committee or equivalent process.

action.recommendation: Confirm the adjuvant off-label discussion, consent and local governance before first treatment.

rules.explanation: Confirm the adjuvant off-label discussion, consent and local governance before first treatment.

action.recommendation: Resolve required renal, calcium, phosphate and magnesium results before the infusion. Baseline also includes FBC and liver profile; vitamin D and dental assessment are as clinically indicated.

rules.explanation: Resolve required renal, calcium, phosphate and magnesium results before the infusion. Baseline also includes FBC and liver profile; vitamin D and dental assessment are as clinically indicated.

action.recommendation: Hypercalcaemia is an exception to routine calcium/vitamin D supplementation in this adjuvant source. Review the cause and supplementation; it does not convert this assessment into a hypercalcaemia-treatment regimen.

rules.explanation: Hypercalcaemia is an exception to routine calcium/vitamin D supplementation in this adjuvant source. Review the cause and supplementation; it does not convert this assessment into a hypercalcaemia-treatment regimen.

action.recommendation: Confirm the prescribed calcium/vitamin D plan and whether hypercalcaemia alters it. NCCP specifies daily supplementation of at least 500 mg calcium and at least 400 IU vitamin D.

rules.explanation: Confirm the prescribed calcium/vitamin D plan and whether hypercalcaemia alters it. NCCP specifies daily supplementation of at least 500 mg calcium and at least 400 IU vitamin D.

action.recommendation: Correct dehydration and reassess renal function before infusion; tailor fluids to the clinical situation.

source.interpretation: Clinical safety interpretation of the hydration requirement and renal toxicity warning

rules.explanation: Correct dehydration and reassess renal function before infusion; tailor fluids to the clinical situation.

action.recommendation: Individualise hydration and avoid overhydration with cardiac failure or fluid-overload risk; no routine echo schedule is specified for this regimen.

rules.explanation: Individualise hydration and avoid overhydration with cardiac failure or fluid-overload risk; no routine echo schedule is specified for this regimen.

action.recommendation: Reconcile duplicate therapy before dosing: do not give another bisphosphonate or additional zoledronic-acid product concurrently.

rules.explanation: Reconcile duplicate therapy before dosing: do not give another bisphosphonate or additional zoledronic-acid product concurrently.

action.recommendation: Review potentially nephrotoxic or calcium-lowering medicines and antiangiogenic therapy; these may increase renal, electrolyte or jaw-osteonecrosis risk.

rules.explanation: Review potentially nephrotoxic or calcium-lowering medicines and antiangiogenic therapy; these may increase renal, electrolyte or jaw-osteonecrosis risk.

action.recommendation: Withhold and arrange urgent assessment for possible severe hypocalcaemia, including tetany, seizure or arrhythmia; do not wait for a routine repeat infusion.

rules.explanation: Withhold and arrange urgent assessment for possible severe hypocalcaemia, including tetany, seizure or arrhythmia; do not wait for a routine repeat infusion.

action.recommendation: Evaluate new thigh, hip or groin pain for an incomplete atypical femoral fracture and consider interruption while assessed; use the individual benefit-risk decision.

rules.explanation: Evaluate new thigh, hip or groin pain for an incomplete atypical femoral fracture and consider interruption while assessed; use the individual benefit-risk decision.

action.recommendation: Investigate persistent ear symptoms, including possible external-auditory-canal osteonecrosis; no fixed dose reduction is specified.

rules.explanation: Investigate persistent ear symptoms, including possible external-auditory-canal osteonecrosis; no fixed dose reduction is specified.

action.recommendation: Arrange prompt clinical/ophthalmic assessment of new eye pain or visual change; ocular inflammation is a recognised adverse effect.

source.interpretation: Clinical safety interpretation of ocular adverse effects

rules.explanation: Arrange prompt clinical/ophthalmic assessment of new eye pain or visual change; ocular inflammation is a recognised adverse effect.

action.recommendation: Withhold and urgently assess severe systemic illness or a suspected serious infusion/allergic reaction. Do not assume fever or sudden illness is only an expected post-dose reaction.

source.interpretation: Clinical safety interpretation of acute-reaction and anaphylaxis risks

rules.explanation: Withhold and urgently assess severe systemic illness or a suspected serious infusion/allergic reaction. Do not assume fever or sudden illness is only an expected post-dose reaction.

summary: No routine premedication is required by NCCP 00545.
Daily oral calcium at least 500 mg and vitamin D at least 400 IU unless hypercalcaemic; confirm the prescribed preparation.
Individualise hydration, avoiding fluid overload; assess renal and electrolyte results before every infusion.
Dental risk assessment, preventive care and the patient reminder card form part of treatment preparation.
supportive_care.mapping_basis: No routine antiemetic premedication is required by the source.
